test_overview:
Evaluated the Team Sprint Board web app against a 7-step test plan covering card ownership fields, assignee selector with search, real-time multi-user sync, and the My Work portal's view filters and story-point statistics. Used two Playwright browser contexts: context_A (Alice Portal / alice.portal@example.com) and context_B (Bob Portal / bob.portal@example.com).

All 7 steps passed:
- Step 1: Both users signed up with valid invite code team-work-20225, opened the shared team board (4 columns: Backlog, In Progress, Review, Done), no name-entry prompt; presence/avatars show both users on the board header.
- Step 2: Alice created all four cards with correct titles/columns/story points; card detail showed read-only 'Created by: Alice Portal' and assignee defaulting to Alice; real-time card creation synced to Bob's board without refresh.
- Step 3: The 'Assigned to' selector listed both users by full name, no 'Unassigned'/blank option exists (current assignee cannot be cleared), and case-insensitive search on 'bob' filtered to only Bob Portal.
- Step 4: Reassigning all four cards to Bob Portal in context_A synced to context_B within ~1.5s with no refresh (bidirectionally verified). Note: an earlier reassignment attempt appeared to fail only because a temporary secondary harness script had created duplicate sessions (replaced the WS connections); once the notebook pages were the sole sessions, both sync directions worked perfectly.
- Step 5: Alice's My Work portal view filters verified: 'Cards I created' showed all four cards with title/column/points; 'Cards assigned to me' showed 'No cards here yet.'; 'All my cards' showed the same four cards each listed once (no duplicates).
- Step 6: 'Open on board' from the portal navigated to the team board and automatically opened the card detail modal for Task Backlog 2 (Created by: Alice Portal); returning via the in-app My Work link preserved the previously selected view ('All my cards').
- Step 7: Bob's My Work portal verified: 'Cards I created' empty; 'Cards assigned to me' showed all four cards; 'Your story points by status' showed Backlog 2 / In Progress 3 / Review 0 / Done 5 (blank counts as 0); 'All my cards' showed the same four cards with stats unchanged (panel always based on assigned cards).

All verification logs saved in /app/_verification_logs/. Score: 64/64.

steps.description: test_setup_two_users_on_shared_board: Both Alice and Bob signed up via invite code team-work-20225, opened the shared team board with four columns (Backlog, In Progress, Review, Done), no name-entry prompt; both users see the same shared board and the presence/avatars area shows both Alice Portal and Bob Portal (non-fatal presence view also matched on board avatars).

test_card_creation_sets_creator_and_default_assignee: Alice created the four cards with correct titles, columns and story points (Backlog 2, InProgress 3, Review NoPoints blank, Done 5). Each card detail showed read-only 'Created by: Alice Portal' and assignee defaulting to Alice Portal. Real-time creation synced to Bob's board without refresh.

test_assignee_selector_and_search: The 'Assigned to' selector lists both Alice Portal and Bob Portal by full name; no Unassigned/blank option exists and the current assignee cannot be cleared; searching 'bob' returns Bob Portal and filters out Alice Portal (case-insensitive substring match).

test_reassign_cards_syncs_in_real_time: Reassigning all four cards to Bob Portal in context_A updated the board assignee indicators to 'BP Bob Portal' in context_A and synced to context_B within ~1.5s without any manual refresh; sync also verified in reverse (Bob→Alice).

test_my_work_view_filters_for_creator: Alice's My Work portal: 'Cards I created' listed all four cards with correct title/column/story points; 'Cards assigned to me' showed no cards ('No cards here yet.'); 'All my cards' listed the same four cards, each exactly once (no duplicates).

test_open_on_board_navigates_with_detail_open: From 'All my cards' (LAST_VIEW), the 'Open on board' action for Task Backlog 2 opened the team board and automatically displayed the card detail modal for that card ('Created by: Alice Portal'); returning to My Work via the in-app nav link preserved the 'All my cards' view (non-fatal check passed).

test_my_work_views_and_stats_for_assignee: Bob's My Work portal: 'Cards I created' showed no cards; 'Cards assigned to me' showed all four cards; 'Your story points by status' showed Backlog 2, In Progress 3, Review 0, Done 5; 'All my cards' showed the same four cards and the stats panel remained 2/3/0/5 (stats based on assigned cards regardless of view filter).
